notes.title: Mayan Death Robots coming to Xbox, price reduced to $6,99 on Steam
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're incredibly excited to announce the release date for Mayan Death Robots: Arena on Xbox One: [b]May 19th[/b], only 2 weeks away! Mayan Death Robots: Arena is the hyper-powered new version of Mayan Death Robots for Xbox One with online multiplayer and matchmaking.

Check out the Xbox store website:
https://www.microsoft.com/store/p/mayan-death-robots-arena/bnw6z1s65chg

[b]To celebrate the upcoming, we're permanently dropping the price of Mayan Death Robots on Steam from $14,99 to $6,99[/b].

Over time, we'd love to bring online multiplayer to the Steam version as well. Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.notes:
A new year, a new patch for Mayan Death Robots! In our first big content update called the [b]Super Weapons Update[/b], we introduce 11 new special weapons as well as bunch of cosmetic improvements.

Here are some examples of the new weapons that you can toy with:
[list]
[*][b]Mirror Image[/b]: create a copy of your robot that mirrors whatever you do until it is destroyed.
[*][b]Time Bomb[/b]: launch a ticking time bomb at your opponent and watch it blow up half of his side after a minute!
[*][b]Kamikaze[/b]: sacrifice yourself for the greater good. Jump to the other side as a fiery ball of doom and destroy his core!
[*]Launch a [b]Blaster Drone[/b] at your opponent that will fly through the map and continually shoot rockets at its target. Chaos guaranteed!
[*][b]Clone Gun[/b]: drop an army of clones from your robot in parachutes from the sky. These clones will jump around and explode when they hit something. Chaos guaranteed!
[/list]

We've also added more loading screens with tips and streamlined the first experience of new players.

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.notes:
We are preparing for a big content patch in the first week of January, but in the meantime we've released a small patch to fix some issues and make minor improvements to the game:

- Aim lines changed to be more visible on all maps (and more beautiful)
- Added new loading screens that explain some gameplay concepts
- Fixed several achievements - some where not triggering properly for everyone
- Several minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Our first patch, which addresses some issues raised by players, is live:

[olist]
[*]By to popular request, Solo Mode has changed: you now have to win the game to proceed to the next event. You only have to defeat each boss once, though.
[*]Previously, players got a blast radius bonus for doing the most damage to a boss. This was unclear to most players. Now, the player who did the most damage will receive additional terrain when positioning his core, and will be the only one to receive a special weapon. This is now shown in a nice "boss defeated" window.
[*]Minor changes to several events (Cooldown, Going Ashore) to reduce frustration.
[*]We split up Quick Match into two game modes. Random Match now selects a random unlocked event from the campaign, while Quick Match now lets you play a basic level with Mayas and nothing else.
[/olist]

We are planning a content patch later this year, so stay tuned! If any issues come up, we'll of course address them in a patch as well.

notes.title: Mayan Death Robots Is Worms With Cyborg Gods
notes.notes:
I adored Worms when I was younger. By the time I’d gotten round to Worms 2, I was (The People’s) elbow-deep in WWF Attitude-era fandom, and named umpteen squads after wrestling teams. I loved it. I loved the weapons, the arenas, the competition – against friends or against the AI. Above all, I loved the turn-based rules the battlefield enforced that made nailing your opponent oh-so-important with each shot. Mayan Death Robots [official site] takes those familiar mechanics, removes the worms, and adds, well, Mayan Death Robots.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Mayan Death Robots launches with new trailer!
notes.notes:
After 2 years of hard work and dedication, we're extremely happy to share the fruits of our labor with you: Mayan Death Robots is now available for the measly price of €13,49 for Windows, Mac and Linux! Invite a friend for some good ol' Friday night gaming, and I promise our game will not disappoint you.

If you're not yet convinced, check out the Launch Trailer we made for the occasion:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7iE9A0-grxw

Thanks to everyone who supported us on the way. This is not the end of the journey, but the beginning. See you in the jungle!

notes.title: Solo play vs AI added to game, online play cut for now
notes.notes:
It’s with great joy that we're announcing the addition of single player versus AI battles to Mayan Death Robots, joining the local PvP multiplayer already in the game. But everything has its price, and this time it’s online play which will no longer be in the game at launch.

We had to work out what we could do for launch with the resources we have, and online just wasn’t feasible right now, so we focused on the single player game. We’ll see later what we can do with online, but for now work on the single player AI is going great and we can’t wait to get it into people’s hands at launch!
